rule_changes.change: Added candidate D (monthly momentum rotation) after A, B, C failed on costs.

backtest_log.result: No candidate passed. Best out-of-sample: B (breakout) with 3 positions, profit factor 1.30, CAGR 8.4%, max drawdown 21.4%, and it lost money in-sample. A is roughly break-even after costs; C loses heavily.

D (monthly momentum rotation) failed. Out-of-sample CAGR 2-3% with a 55% drawdown. In-sample CAGR above 50% is not credible: about 70% of the profit came from two Adani stocks that were not Nifty 100 members at the time (survivorship bias).

Retest with point-in-time Nifty 100 membership (rebuilt from NSE Indices press releases, 2013 onward). All four candidates fail. D in-sample falls from about 52% to 7-9% a year, below Nifty 50 buy-and-hold, with a 51% drawdown. 15 of 189 historical members have no price data (mostly merged or delisted).
Retest at 25,000 with 3 and 5 positions: all four candidates fail. Best is D with 3 positions in-sample (9.9% a year, 52% drawdown), which loses 2.3% a year out-of-sample.

live_plan: Nifty 50 index fund or ETF, buy and hold. No active strategy approved.
